intro: The Grove dresser proves that compact doesn’t mean compromise. A full-length mirror, smart storage, and eco-friendly materials create a sleek, functional piece that keeps your space calm, clutter-free, and effortlessly chic.

features.title: Made for small spaces, built for big impact
features.text: Thoughtfully designed to maximise function without overwhelming your room, our dresser makes even the smallest spaces feel open and organised.

features.title: A mirror that makes life easier

features.title: Sustainable materials for a healthier home

features.title: Storage that keeps up with you
features.text: A smart utility drawer ensures your essentials are always within reach, so you never have to search for what you need.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
